Three things worth your attention before you run it.

Your tests aren't failing. The transcript you gave me is green everywhere — dotnet test at 971/0, ci_local.sh --with-all through all six gates, E2E at 8 passed / 7 skipped. Slice 8's enhanced-navigation fix worked; scenarios 3, 4 and 6 are genuinely green for the first time. There was nothing to fix, so I didn't invent anything.

The one src/ change is a bare <span> becoming <span class="order-party-line-name"> in the party list. It was the only text on the ordering surface with no way to address it — your own lines carry .order-line-name, the kitchen's carry .kitchen-line-name. A new class rather than reusing .order-line-name, because that one is font-weight: 600 and the rest of the table should read quieter; the new name has no CSS behind it, so nothing moves on screen. I verified every other scenario body in both files is byte-identical to what you have.

Housekeeping — Slice 8's note was wrong. It claimed fifteen unmerged appends. You'd already merged most; only m5-slice-4 and m5-slice-5 remain.
